fields.Name: Members with Events but No Courses
fields.Description: Skip analytics conversation from the More Cheese suite

fields.Message: Find all members who have attended at least one event but have never enrolled in a course. Show me a table with their names and the number of events they've attended. I want to click on a member to see which specific events they attended. [NO CHAT]

Here you go, your Event-Only Member Engagement Explorer is ready, pulling data from Member Profiles, Event Registrations, Events, and Course Enrollments. It displays qualifying members with their total event counts in a sortable master table alongside summary engagement KPIs. You can click on any member row to immediately inspect their detailed chronological attendance history or export the targeted cohort.
